text_block_list.text:
Finishing the day's work, I stretch 
lightly. At that moment, the calendar 
catches my eye...
choice_data_list:
(Come to think of it, tomorrow is 
Valentine's Day.)

text_block_list.text:
It seemed like an event Believe wouldn't 
be very interested in, but... tomorrow 
just happens to be a rest day.

She'll probably drop by the trainer's 
office eventually, so it might be a good 
idea to buy some sweets or snacks to give 
her when she does.

...was what I'd been casually thinking, 
but...
(ROOOOOOOAAAAR...!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
A crazy storm hitting on a day like this, 
for real~!? And I was supposed to go eat 
chocolate cake~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
The doctor told us to stop training and 
refrain from going out, didn't they~...

"Unlike the students, there's no official 
curfew for staff, but going out shopping 
in this weather is practically out of the 
question. Thinking I'd at least check the 
school store, I headed over, but—"

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
And that's pretty much what *everyone* 
thought~. Sorry, Trainer, all the sweets 
are completely sold out!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to head to the trainer's 
office... Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so Valentine's sweets, then.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, or rather... I'm sorry, I haven't 
prepared anything.
choice_data_list: No, not at all! Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? But...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Could you head back to the 
trainer's office first?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I... have somewhere I need to stop by, 
so...

And so, I waited a while for Believe to 
arrive. Then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting. When I stopped 
by the cafeteria kitchen—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I was able to get some. Baking soda for 
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
We have refined white sugar ready here, 
right? And mineral water too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
With just that, we can make it. "Honeycomb 
toffee."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
First, put sugar and water into the ladle, 
then heat it while stirring so it doesn't 
burn.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Once the sugar water reaches the right 
temperature, remove it from the heat, add 
baking soda, and stir all at once.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It'll expand when you do that, so after 
that, just wait until it cools down—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's ready. Here you go, Trainer.

I take a bite of the honeycomb toffee I 
received from Believe. The surface is 
crisp and has a delightfully light 
texture...

The simple sweetness of pure sugar fills 
my mouth. Yet underneath, there's a subtle 
bitterness and a caramel-like aroma, 
giving it a wonderfully deep flavor...

Or rather, this is visibly on another 
level compared to the honeycomb toffee I 
know! This is probably of super-high 
quality!
choice_data_list: This is... this is amazing, Believe!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're praising me a bit too much, but 
thank you. I think part of it is just that 
it's freshly made, though—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
My grandfather taught me how to make it. I 
think that's definitely the biggest 
reason.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Um. So, with that said, is this all 
right? The sweets, I mean...

Somehow I ended up being treated by 
Believe, even though I was originally 
supposed to prepare sweets for her...

And so, gazing at the plenty of leftover 
white sugar and baking soda, I made up my 
mind.
choice_data_list: I'll try making one too! Just wait a sec!
I'll try making one too! Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Um, yes—

The recipe is extremely simple, and having 
just watched it, I should easily be able 
to recreate it!
choice_data_list:
(Heat up the sugar water... add baking 
soda...!)

text_block_list.text:
...And so, she bravely took up the 
challenge, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I think the stirring speed when adding 
the baking soda was just a bit too slow.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"You should add the baking soda once the 
large bubbles in the sugar water settle 
down... but if you wait too long, the 
temperature will drop too much and it 
won't rise properly."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Also, the sugar water might have been 
heated a bit too much... Isn't it burning 
at the bottom of the ladle?

A realization dawned on me. She had 
whipped it up so effortlessly earlier that 
it seemed simple at first glance, but...
choice_data_list: Is this... really hard to make...?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...The procedure is fairly simple.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However, there are a lot of points to be 
cautious about... and quite a few things 
that need to be dealt with quickly in a 
short amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...So, um. Please don't worry about my 
share.

We can't do that. You did just treat me to 
a meal earlier, so—

Above all else. I want to reward Believe, 
who always works quietly and tirelessly, 
with some delicious sweets—that's why.
choice_data_list:
First... take me as your apprentice, 
Believe!

First... please take me as your disciple, 
Believe!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh... You want to learn from someone? 
From me?
choice_data_list:
I look forward to working with you, 
Master!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...Umm. I... I understand."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You judge the temperature of the sugar 
water by the size of the bubbles, its 
thickness, and its color. The bubbles 
should be fine, and the thickness should 
form thin threads—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's heated too much already. The 
color isn't amber anymore, it's getting 
closer to caramel."
choice_data_list: Sorry, please let me try again...!
Sorry, let me do that over...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Once you add the baking soda, stir 
quickly. ...A bit too slow. ...The mixing 
is uneven."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, stop! You're mixing it a bit too 
much. If you do that—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Um. What would you like to do?
choice_data_list: Will you let me try again...?!
Will you let me try again...?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(She won't budge either. ...This one, 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll teach you. Once more, 
from the beginning.

Determined to search 'karumeyaki uses' 
later, I continued to challenge the task 
of making karumeyaki with Believe again 
and again.
And then—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: *nibble*...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It's delicious.

To be honest, it still looked quite 
misshapen... but for now, I managed to 
hand over one properly puffed-up piece.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's it. Now do it quickly. —Stop 
right there!

Together with Believe, we watched the 
ladle with bated breath! The baking soda 
and sugar water mixture puffed right up—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ………………It's not deflating.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's finished.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations, Trainer-san. I believe 
it was an absolute masterpiece.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to my master's 
teachings...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh, no... nothing like that...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, um... Could we maybe stop with 
the "Master" thing soon?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That tickles, a little.

That was when I finally noticed what was 
happening outside. Setting aside the fact 
that the storm had passed before we even 
realized it—

To be honest, I would have liked to brew a 
cup of tea for her, but it really is time 
she went home.

I quickly wrapped up the honeycomb toffee 
I'd somehow managed to make, handed it to 
Believe, and sent her off.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Well then... excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Cinder toffee is...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(If I remember right... these keep for 
quite a while. As long as you keep 
moisture out, about a month or so.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I guess eating it a little bit at a time 
works too.
